perspective:
From the RECOMMENDER’s perspective:

- I greeted the seeker and asked if they had seen *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017).
- The seeker said hi, said they hadn’t seen it yet, and said they were looking for a good thriller/suspense movie.
- I asked if they had seen *Split* (2017).
- The seeker mentioned *Gone Baby Gone* (2007) as the kind of thing they meant, and said they had watched “that one” and it was good — indicating they had seen and liked *Split*.
- I recommended *Don’t Breathe* (2016) as good.
- The seeker said “I really liked it... I haven’t seen that one yet. What is it about?” — so I understood they liked *Split* but had not yet seen *Don’t Breathe*, and were asking me what *Don’t Breathe* is about.
